test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Acts was passed by the Government of India to inquire into allegations of corruption against certain public functionaries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Lokpal and Lokayukta Act.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Lokpal and Lokayukta Act **provides for the establishment of a body of Lokpal for the Union and Lokayukta for States__ to inquire into allegations of corruption against certain public functionaries and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
 
• Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 was Passed by the UPA II government headed by then PM Manmohan Singh.
 
• Retired Supreme Court judge Pinaki Chandra Ghose was appointed as the first Lokpal of India.
 
• Lokpal and Lokayuktas act as an Ombudsman.
 
• In 2016, the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 was amended and enabled the leader of the single largest opposition party in the Lok Sabha to be a member of the selection committee.
